# The BlowUp

> The BlowUp is a hands-on masterclass for filmmakers, musicians and sound engineers in Ghana — learn from industry professionals, sharpen your craft, and connect with the people who make hits. BlowUp also runs live events with online ticketing.

## Overview
The BlowUp brings creatives together for practical, industry-led masterclass sessions in three tracks, plus showcases, screenings and other live events.

## Key Facts
- **Name**: The BlowUp
- **Website**: https://www.theblowupgh.com
- **Location**: Ghana (open to participants from beyond Ghana)
- **Format**: Masterclass (hands-on, industry-led sessions)
- **Tracks**: Film Director; Musician; Sound Engineer / Beat Programmer
- **Registration deadline**: July 23, 2027
- **How to register**: Create an account at https://www.theblowupgh.com/register, choose a track, and pay online (Mobile Money or card). Your place is confirmed when payment goes through.
- **Events & tickets**: https://www.theblowupgh.com/events — tickets appear in the buyer's dashboard with a QR code.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Who is the masterclass for?**: Filmmakers, musicians, sound engineers and beat programmers who want to level up.
- **Can I join more than one track?**: One track per person per season.
- **Is the fee refundable?**: Non-refundable once payment is confirmed, except if the masterclass is cancelled.
